newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine April maize slouches after lower Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine April maize slouches after lower Chicago.

text.p: Argentine April cash maize ambled downwards in middling volume, with bids slouching after a lower Chicago, Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange traders said.

Cash January wheat fell in good volume turnover with continuing concern over competitive international markets. Cash May soybeans were steady in slim volume, with the market cautious about future price trends. Spot soybeans firmed, also in thin trade. Cash sunflower seed was weaker to steady in moderate volume. Oil sales are chugging along nicely but crush margins are scanty.
